name: srsRAN Project (5G)
what_it_is: srsRAN Project is an open-source 5G RAN implementation providing a complete CU/DU stack (L1/2/3) developed by Software Radio Systems (SRS). It supports both monolithic gNB and split CU/DU deployments, with options for real SDR hardware or ZMQ-based RF simulation.
configuration: Monolithic vs. split CU/DU architecture selection
ZMQ simulation vs. real SDR hardware (UHD driver) selection
DPDK enablement for high-bandwidth low-latency scenarios
modes: Monolithic gNB (combined CU and DU in a single process)
Split architecture (separate CU and DU instances)
ZMQ RF simulation mode (no physical SDR hardware required)
constraints: Requires Linux kernel 5.4+ and libsctp for SCTP transport
ZMQ simulation requires libzmq; SDR hardware mode requires UHD driver
DPDK support is optional but required for high-bandwidth low-latency deployments
Split-8 configurations require UHD or ZMQ fronthaul driver; Split-7.2 does not
Mandatory build dependencies: libfftw, libsctp, yaml-cpp, mbedTLS
Repository is archived as of December 2025; active development moved to OCUDU
Requires a compatible 5G core network (e.g., Open5GS) — does not include a 5GC
docker_services: gnb (srsran/gnb image, container: srsran_gnb, networks: ran 10.53.1.3 and metrics 172.19.1.3)
notable_absences: No built-in 5G core network — depends on external Open5GS or compatible 5GC
No UE (user equipment) simulator included in this repository
No built-in traffic generation or application-layer testing tools
No observable metrics or KPI export mechanism documented
No fault injection or impairment simulation features documented
